# CodeWeavers — CrossOver compatibility record

- Original source: [CodeWeavers — CrossOver compatibility record](https://www.codeweavers.com/compatibility/crossover/robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood)
- Author / publication: CodeWeavers and community testers
- Language / date: English; version-specific ratings, retrieved 2026-09-09
- Access: Compatibility overview and version listing inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The retrieved page distinguishes macOS and Linux results for running the Windows application through CrossOver. It displays Limited Functionality for macOS with version 24.0.3 and Runs Great for Linux with version 22.0.0.

The Linux result is explicitly flagged as outdated. These labels must remain attached to their tested versions rather than becoming a blanket compatibility recommendation.

The page provides a version history and says manual installation is required. It does not establish which missions were completed or reproduce a current configuration. This concerns a compatibility layer, distinct from the game's native Mac and Linux ports.
